desc: Derive divisibility condition: s[i..j] divisible by last digit d iff value(i..j−1)·10 ≡ 0 (mod d) iff prefix value P[i−1] ≡ P[j−1] (mod m) where m = d/gcd(d,10); verified against examples.
Reduce moduli set to m ∈ {1,2,3,4,7,9} (m=1 trivial: contributes j+1).

Implement: prefix remainders + Counter dicts for m ∈ {2,3,4,7,9}; skip query on '0' (still update mods); m==1 → ans += j+1; else query pre-update remainder; counters seeded with {0:1}; correct query/update ordering.
Test against examples: "12936" → 11, "5701283" → 18, "1010101010" → 25; brute-force cross-check on exhaustive small and random strings — all matched.
Confirm complexity O(5n) time, O(Σm) space; answer fits Python int.
